arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, but I noticed it's quite minimal — right now it mainly shows your email address. I'd suggest adding a short bio, a photo, and maybe some info about your work or interests to make it feel more personal and engaging. Also, you might want to double-check which email you'd like displayed publicly, since there seem to be two listed. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking — that's a great topic with lots of potential. Right now the site is very brief, so I'd suggest adding posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, and maybe tips for beginners. That would make it much more engaging for readers. Looking forward to seeing it grow!
